title: serving-runtime-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-30
content:
Morning scratchpad (quick dump) - 2026-03-30

Context:
- Working on headroom regressions after last kernel update (nvfuser+custom attention). Some customers on Dedicated saw 8-12% throughput drop on long sequences (>2k).
- Prior notes: kernel_switch_v2 landed in main last week (PR 842). We shipped canary to staging cluster.

Top of mind / Today:
- triage INF-4723 (customer report: dedicated cluster latency spike on model-rwkv-13b @ seq=4096)
  - reproduce locally with seq=4096, batch=1, kv-cache warmed.
  - quick repro shows 9% CPU steal and extra 30ms p99 on token emit.
  - suspect kernel_switch_v2 interaction with KV cache eviction path.
- perf microbench: run microbench/kernel_switch_v2 vs kernel_switch_v1 for llama-13b, seq 512/1024/2048/4096 (use perf-run-2026-03-30.sh)
- add telemetry to detect kernel variant per-request (lightweight header in trace) so we can correlate in prod metrics

Bug triage (short list):
- INF-4723 (see above) - assign to Marco for kernel stacktrace + flamegraph. Priority: P1 for affected Dedicated customers.
- GH #859 - batching deadlock when using dynamic batching + fallback path. Repro steps in comment 4. Maybe related to recent queue refactor. Status: assigned to Li.
- GH #860 - quantized inference (4-bit) outputs slightly different logits vs fp16 for seq>1024. Need eval harness run across open-llama validation set.

Perf TODOs / experiments:
- experiment A: force old kernel for long sequences (env KERNEL_FORCE=kernel_switch_v1) on canary and compare throughput/cost; quick A/B for 24h.
- experiment B: tweak kv-cache eviction threshold from 0.75 to 0.9 in runtime config — hypothesis: frequent evictions cause rerouting to slower path.
- experiment C: enable continuous batching cap at 1.5x window for long sequences to see if batching amortizes kernel overhead.
- run end-to-end E2E perf (throughput, p50/p95/p99, token cost) and snapshot artifacts to confluence page (linked above).

Kernel notes (raw):
- kernel_switch_v2: refactors attention kernel selection, introduces new fallback that tries to keep register allocations smaller. Wins: shorter seq < 1024; Loses: longer seq due to additional memcopy in cold path.
- suspected hotspot: kv_cache_evict_and_repack() -> copies map entries, copies KV tensors; cost increases with the number of keyed caches (~clients with long walks).
- quick patch idea: add "fast-path" check that avoids repack if eviction set small (<128 entries) and sequence_len > 2048. Could shave 20-40ms in repro.

Commands / reproducer notes:
- local repro script: scripts/repro/inf-4723-repro.sh (seq overrides via -s). Use CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, disable other background workloads.
- perf flamegraph: tools/prof/gen_flame.sh --pid <runtime_pid> --duration 60s --out /tmp/flame-inf-4723.svg
- microbench script: tools/microbench/bench_kernel_switch.py --model llama-13b --seq 4096 --batch 1 --iters 1000

Observability / telemetry items to add:
- per-request kernel_variant tag (kernel_switch_v1|v2) on traces (low overhead, boolean header).
- metric: kv_cache_eviction_count by model + tenant_id.
- alert: Dedicated p99 latency increase >5% for 30m with >100 QPS and kernel_variant=v2.

Short-term plan (next 48h):
1) repro INF-4723 locally (Aisha + Marco) - today
2) run microbench matrix for v1 vs v2 across seq lengths (Aisha) - today afternoon
3) patch: add fast-path in kv eviction that avoids heavy repack for small evictions (Marco) - tomorrow morning
4) Canary test: force v1 for long-seq on 2 staging clusters and compare - tomorrow afternoon
5) rollout decision by EOD Friday

Notes to self:
- remember to post interim findings in #eng-serving-runtime and tag SRE for canary rollout window.
- check customer addon config: some Dedicated tenants pin runtime=1.14 which may already have v1 behavior.

Loose ideas / backlog (not urgent):
- smarter eviction scheduler that defers repack to low-load windows; could integrate with SLO-aware scheduler.
- evaluate REPACK-less KV store (append-only vector + compact in background) - might be bigger refactor.
- metric: per-tenant seq_length_p95 to auto-suggest quantization/profile in Redwood Optimize.

Meeting notes snippet (sync 2026-03-29):
- Li: batching refactor looked fine in microbench but deadlock repro in integration when fallback path hits. Plan to add timeout in queue processing.
- Marco: flamegraph shows ~30% time in memcpy during eviction for seq>2k. Trying small fast-path patch.
- Aisha: propose canary with kernel force v1 for long seq. Need SRE approval.

Random TODOs (personal):
- PR review: #844 (observability change) - leave comment about schema.
- follow up with product on customer impact timeline for INF-4723.
- update perf confluence with raw numbers and attach flamegraphs.

End of dump.
summary: Daily scratchpad: triage INF-4723 (latency spike long-seq), perf experiments (v1 vs v2), kernel kv-cache eviction fast-path idea, commands/repro scripts, obs telemetry to add, plan for next 48h.
